story1.title: Pip the Little Otter
pages: Pip is a little otter. He lives near the river.
He finds a small basket. He hugs it tight.
He swims through calm water. He kicks his feet.
He finds round stones. He puts them in the basket.
He naps in the warm sun. He dreams of the river.
